en.title: Ă
en.summary: The letter Ă is a character in the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: This letter is called /ə/. Its main sound is the sound /ə/, heard in the word (ăsta) /ˈmə.r/, which means apple. This letter makes only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Relax your tongue in the middle of your mouth. Keep your lips neutral and slightly open. Let the air flow freely without tension. Your voice vibrates. Touch your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /ə/ in every word position. You hear it stressed in the word (măr) /mər/. You also hear it unstressed at the end of the word (apă) /ˈa.pə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace this sound with the open vowel in the English word cat. Do not round your lips as you do in the English word fur. Keep your lips relaxed and completely still.
